customMethods.name: saveFolder
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("saveFolder() called")
	
	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	folderInfo = dict(self.view.custom.values)
	folderId = folderInfo['folderId']

	if folderId is None:
		if system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('folderId', system.kanoa.dashboard.getFolders({'folderName': folderInfo['folderName'], 'parentId': folderInfo['parentId']})):
			system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message': 'This folder already exists'})
			return
	
		folderId, msg = system.kanoa.dashboard.addFolder(folderInfo, userId)
		if msg is None: msg = 'Folder added'
	else:
		retVal, msg = system.kanoa.dashboard.updateFolder(folderInfo, userId)
		if msg is None: msg = 'Folder updated'
		
	system.perspective.sendMessage('showInfoToast', {'message': msg})		
		
	self.view.params.value.folderId = folderId
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.treeData")	 #Update the Tree Selector
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshDashboardFolders", {})
	system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': msg})
	
	return

customMethods.name: deleteFolder
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("deleteFolder() called")
	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	retVal, msg = system.kanoa.dashboard.deleteFolder(self.view.custom.values.folderId, userId)
	if msg is not None:	system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': "Couldn't delete this folder. This may be due to sub-folders or Matrices in this folder."})
	else:
		self.view.params.value.folderId = None
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Folder deleted'})		

	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.treeData")	 #Update the Tree Selector
	system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshDashboardFolders", {})

	return
